svg.title: Pads on a copper pour: the same mask opening shows FR4 or copper
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of the corner of a 0.5 mm-pitch QFN, three times, with the exposed pad at the top left. Every pad has the same mask opening, 0.075 mm larger than the pad. Left, marked right: the two ground pads at the corner each have a single trace to a via, and bare FR4 shows around them inside their openings, like every other pad. Middle, marked wrong: a ground pour surrounds the corner and the two ground pads are tied straight into it, so copper fills their openings and they look larger than the other pads. Right, marked right: the pour is kept back from the two ground pads and joins them through thin thermal spokes, so they look like the other pads again.

g.text: Mask opening, the same on every pad
Bare FR4 shows around the copper
Ground pad tied straight into the pour
Copper fills its opening, so it looks like a bigger pad
Only a sliver of copper shows, like a trace
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Corner of a 0.5 mm-pitch QFN, 0.25 mm pads.
Mask openings 0.075 mm larger than each pad
Pour clearance and relief gap 0.25 mm,
